title: Batch 1 Is Almost Sold out! Join the Mentra Founder's Club
summary: Introducing the Founder's 1000 Club. There's only a few glasses left in Batch 1 that gains you automatic entry. More
body_markdown:
Quick update: Batch 1 of Mentra Live is nearing capacity.


If you want to be part of the **Founder's 1,000** shipping on **February 13** , now is the time to lock in your spot. There's only a few left!


**Why Batch 1 Matters**


⭐ **Founder’s 1000 Club status**


Get early access to upcoming Mentra MiniApps, experimental features, and private community drops.


🚀 **Be first to shape the platform**


Founder's 1000 Club Mentra Live owners will help us influence what comes next for the Mentra ecosystem, joining a special private Discord group with the founders.


🎯 **Hands-free AI + apps at $299**


Mentra Live unlocks POV streaming, AI tools, and more. Choose your reality on the only smart glasses with an app store.


Lock in Your[Batch 1 Price here](https://mentraglass.com/) .


**New Demos Every Week**


Want to see real demos and sneak peeks dropping weekly, like behind-the-scenes look at our upcoming "Choose Your Reality" advertising campaign? Thanks for being part of the Mentra community!
